test_m1 = '''"""Tests for milestone m1: Handle tz-aware datetimes in naturalday."""

from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone


def test_naturalday_tz_aware_returns_correct_day(monkeypatch):
    """When system UTC is Oct 15 and value is Oct 16 AEDT (+11), naturalday should return 'Oct 16'."""
    from unittest.mock import patch
    import humanize.time as time_module

    # System UTC date is Oct 15
    utc_oct15 = date(2023, 10, 15)
    # When UTC is Oct 15 ~13:00, AEDT (+11) is already Oct 16
    aedt_now = datetime(2023, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=11)))

    monkeypatch_datetime = __import__('conftest', fromlist=['monkeypatch_datetime']).monkeypatch_datetime
    monkeypatch_datetime(monkeypatch, utc_oct15, aedt_now)

    tz_val = datetime(2023, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=11)))
    result = time_module.naturalday(tz_val)
    assert result == "Oct 16"


def test_naturalday_naive_datetime_unchanged(monkeypatch):
    """Naive datetimes should keep existing behavior (compare against date.today())."""
    import humanize.time as time_module

    today = date(2023, 10, 16)
    naive_dt = datetime(2023, 10, 16, 12, 0)

    monkeypatch_datetime = __import__('conftest', fromlist=['monkeypatch_datetime']).monkeypatch_datetime
    monkeypatch_datetime(monkeypatch, today, naive_dt)

    result = time_module.naturalday(naive_dt)
    assert result == "Oct 16"


def test_naturalday_plain_date_unchanged(monkeypatch):
    """Plain date objects should keep existing behavior."""
    import humanize.time as time_module

    today = date(2023, 10, 16)
    plain_date = date(2023, 10, 16)

    monkeypatch_datetime = __import__('conftest', fromlist=['monkeypatch_datetime']).monkeypatch_datetime
    monkeypatch_datetime(monkeypatch, today)

    result = time_module.naturalday(plain_date)
    assert result == "Oct 16"
'''

with open('crucible_hidden/test_m1.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(test_m1)
